_: behaviour -> the test(s) that name it. Option C (docs/design/tagging.md): the corpus carries the mapping, so no test file is edited. Keyed on file + title, the same as snip-it.tests.json.
_authored: 2026-09-05, by reading kit.beh against kit.test.js. This is the corpus Kit uses on ITSELF — `node check.js kit --repo .` from the repo root, wired into ci.yml. Kit is now the only app in the estate whose build fails if one of its own documented behaviours loses the test that names it. Extended the same day with BEH-UI-*, the read API — the first behaviours here with a network surface, and the first two of those are security properties.
_honest: A mapping entry is a HUMAN'S CLAIM that the named test asserts the behaviour. Nothing here checks the test body. That limit is C's and it is not fixable by parsing; it is stated in docs/design/tagging.md and repeated in check.js's output, because a gate quoted second-hand loses its caveats first.

BEH-GATE-1.title: exit 1 when a behaviour has no test naming it — the gate can go RED

BEH-GATE-2.title: exit 2 when the repo has no test files at all

BEH-GATE-3.title: REFUSES a mapping naming a title that file does not have — the renamed-test case

BEH-READ-1.title: exit 2 when the JS reader and the JS count disagree — the half that had no guard

BEH-GEN-1.title: an unbound noun is REFUSED, and the missing noun is named

BEH-GEN-2.title: an unsupplied ROUTE PARAM is refused — the real bug this caught

BEH-PARSE-1.title: an unrecognised keyword is an error, not silently dropped

BEH-RESOLVE-1.title: a hole is filled by a DIFFERENT behaviour

BEH-RESOLVE-2.title: two behaviours disagreeing IS a conflict, with both sides named

BEH-ADJ-1.title: an inference defaults to unreviewed WITHOUT anyone writing review

BEH-WRITE-1.title: writer: every comment in the corpus survives an edit, byte for byte
writer: a step lands at the end of its own block, not after the blank line

BEH-WRITE-2.title: writer: an edit that would not parse is refused, and the text is unchanged

BEH-WRITE-3.title: writer: an edit that changes a NEIGHBOURING behaviour is refused

BEH-WRITE-4.title: writer: it contains no path to git at all — decision 2, checked not promised
